Bug_Title: Members ignored during record serialization should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The `showBug` method uses the noncompliant writeObject method in a record, which is not allowed. In Records, serialization is not done the same way as for ordinary serializable or externalizable classes.
Trigger_Explanation: This test case is designed to trigger the bug by calling the showBug() method of the Record class. The showBug() method uses the noncompliant writeObject method in a record, which is not allowed. In Records, serialization is not done the same way as for ordinary serializable or externalizable classes.
